nativeComparisons.compares: CLI output bytes against .build/reference/ffmpeg run at test time (commit 946fcce0, --disable-x86asm asserted from build-metadata.json): 432 sweep framecrc, 168 composed/time-selection framecrc, 40 frame-grouping f64le, 40 WAV/raw files, 44 width=0 and empty-input framecrc on every platform; 23 refusals against native exit status

unsupported: shape=sinusoidal (the native default, so bare flanger) - refused: needs libm sin()
Integer forms of shape/interp constants - refused
Option expressions, SI suffixes, hexadecimal, inf/nan and min/max/default names - refused
Automatic sample-rate conversion around flanger - refused
LFO length < 1 sample, >= 2^30, or channels*lfo_length > INT_MAX - refused before output
AIFF/AU output and non-linux/x64 double arithmetic (except width=0) - no native evidence

proposedContracts.name: matches native framecrc across sources, channel counts, rates and option sweeps into source and f64 outputs
proposedContracts.scope: framecrc of u8/s16/s32/f32/f64 raw sources, 1-3 channels, 8000/44100 Hz, eight option sets sweeping every option and both interpolations, source codec and f64 outputs (432 comparisons)

proposedContracts.name: matches native composed chains, frame grouping and output -ss/-t/-frames:a
proposedContracts.scope: six composed chains (asetnsamples=7 and asetnsamples=n=29:p=0 before, volume after, apad before/after) under output -ss/-t/-frames:a, s16/f64 mono/stereo (168), plus 40 frame-grouping comparisons with asetnsamples=n=1|7|29|50:p=0

proposedContracts.name: writes native-identical WAV and raw files from WAV and raw inputs, with output time selection
proposedContracts.scope: WAV and raw outputs from raw and WAV inputs in all five PCM formats, with and without output -ss/-t (40)

proposedContracts.name: matches native exactly where width=0 leaves the input unchanged, on every platform
proposedContracts.scope: width=0 (output equals input under any contraction) over five formats, 1/3 channels, with and without -t, plus 4 configured empty inputs (44)

proposedContracts.name: fails explicitly before output where native fails, and for accepted forms that remain unimplemented
proposedContracts.scope: native exit status for 22 option forms (8 natively accepted but unimplemented, 14 native errors including enable=) and rate conversion; no output file created

proposedContracts.name: refuses flanger state above the buffer budget before opening output
proposedContracts.scope: PCM plan refuses a 1764000-byte LFO table above maxBufferBytes with resource-budget before output

proposedContracts.name: parses triangular shapes, positional and named options, the last value and native ranges
proposedContracts.scope: flanger option syntax, positional/named order, last-wins

proposedContracts.name: refuses the sinusoidal default, native range errors, enable and unimplemented forms with exact messages
proposedContracts.scope: exact refusal messages for native errors, the sinusoidal default, enable and unimplemented forms

proposedContracts.name: transcribes init and config_input scaling, the triangular LFO table and the LFO-length constraint
proposedContracts.scope: init/config_input values, triangular LFO table with rint half-even, LFO-length and channel-phase constraints

proposedContracts.name: negotiates pinned dblp from every input format and keeps counts, packets and reservations
proposedContracts.scope: dblp negotiation for every input format, requiresScalarRounding, capabilities, planSamples/packetSections/plannedReservations/reservations

proposedContracts.name: matches a transcription of the C loop for every option family, with identical output for 1/7/29/50-sample splits and owned outputs
proposedContracts.scope: filter_frame transcription over seven option sets, 1/3 channels, whole and 1/7/29/50-sample splits; ownership; integer input conversion

proposedContracts.name: enforces allocation, state, format and cancellation limits
proposedContracts.scope: state and frame allocation limits, stable format, invalid frames and AbortSignal

notes: No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
Per spec registry notes: formats() is the native array ["dblp"]; no negotiate/nativeFormats/flacInput declared.

The linux-x64 gate on the double-arithmetic cases is a precaution from the determinism notes (macOS FMA contraction); no macOS difference was measured in this sandbox. width=0 cases are exact under contraction and run everywhere.
Frame-grouping evidence uses asetnsamples=n=N:p=0; the composed asetnsamples=7 chain compares with native running the same chain.
Integer outputs need -cpuflags 0 (dblp to integer conversion); every differential case passes it.

Setup durations: first bootstrap attempt failed immediately under sandbox Node v22.23.5 (Node 24+ required); rerun with preinstalled /opt/node24 (v24.22.3): npm 8.9s, submodule 6.0s, reference build, 196.7s total (3m18s wall). Baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 61s; registry unit tests 4s; flanger differential file ~18s with --maxWorkers=1.
Environment: FLAC codec artifacts not built (not selected), as expected; no other problems.
